### ***Last Friday Night..***

*You woke up in what looks like Mina’s house. You’re head pounding as you sat up, you saw that you were in a bed. A bed next to Bakugo sleeping. Denki in a table sleeping with glitter. Kirishima with a tequila bottle in the couch. Mina in the bathroom bathtub with glitter and Sero hanging with his tape, he had made a hammock for himself. You were wondering..what happened last night?*

*You stood up from the bed and were about to walk into the living room but you fell to the floor due to the floor being soaking wet. Due to your fall, making a loud sound. Everyone else woke up and started to wonder what happened as well.*
